derivation_summary: Factor numerator as perfect-square trinomial (3x+5)^2, factor denominator trinomial (3x+5)(x+3), cancel common factor (3x+5) to get (3x+5)/(x+3), then a+b+c=11.
Expand (2x+7)^2=4x^2+28x+49, recognize (2x-3)(2x+3)=4x^2-9 via difference of squares, distribute negative sign: 4x^2+28x+49-4x^2+9=28x+58.
Factor numerator 9x^2-16 as difference of squares (3x+4)(3x-4), cancel common factor (3x+4) with denominator, yielding 3x-4.
Distribute 3x over (2x+4) to get 6x^2+12x, then combine like terms 12x-6x=6x, result 6x^2+6x.
Apply difference of squares pattern (a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2 with a=4x, b=11: (4x)^2-11^2=16x^2-121.
Distribute 2 over (5x^2-3x) and -3 over (x^2+4x-9), then combine like terms: 10x^2-6x-3x^2-12x+27=7x^2-18x+27.
Expand (3x+5)^2 and (3x-5)^2, subtract to get 60x (or use difference of squares on the squared terms), substitute x=4 to get 240.
Divide each term by 6x^2: 18x^5/6x^2=3x^3, -12x^3/6x^2=-2x, 6x^2/6x^2=1, giving 3x^3-2x+1.
Factor 49x^2-121 as difference of squares (7x+11)(7x-11), cancel (7x+11) with denominator to get 7x-11.
Recognize 9x^4-25y^6=(3x^2)^2-(5y^3)^2 as difference of squares, factor as (3x^2+5y^3)(3x^2-5y^3), cancel (3x^2+5y^3) to get 3x^2-5y^3.
Factor numerator x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) (diff of squares), factor denominator x^2+7x+12=(x+3)(x+4) (trinomial), cancel (x+3) to get (x-3)/(x+4).
Polynomial long division: 6x^3+11x^2-19x+6 divided by 2x-1 gives quotient 3x^2+7x-6 with remainder 0.
Partial fractions: set 7x+11=A(x+4)+B(x-1), substitute x=1 gives A=18/5, substitute x=-4 gives B=17/5, A+B=35/5=7.
Synthetic division of 2x^3-13x^2+17x+12 by (x-4): coefficients 2,-13,17,12 with root 4 gives 2,-5,-3,0, so quotient is 2x^2-5x-3.
Find common denominator (x+5)(x-2), cross-multiply: 2x(x-2)+3(x+5)=2x^2-4x+3x+15=2x^2-x+15.
Distribute 3 over (2x+4) to get 6x+12, then combine like terms 6x-2x=4x, result 4x+12.
Factor 6x^2-19x+10 by grouping: split -19x into -4x-15x, group as 2x(3x-2)-5(3x-2)=(2x-5)(3x-2), cancel (3x-2) to get 2x-5.
Distribute 5 over (2x^3-7x) to get 10x^3-35x, then combine -35x+3x=-32x, result 10x^3-32x.
Distribute 7 over (3x-4) to get 21x-28, combine 21x+5x=26x, result 26x-28.
FOIL (7x-3)(2x+11): 14x^2+77x-6x-33, combine like terms 77x-6x=71x, result 14x^2+71x-33.
Divide monomial: 42/7=6 for coefficients, x^(11-4)=x^7 for exponents, result 6x^7.
Distribute 5 over (3x-4) to get 15x-20, combine 15x-2x=13x, result 13x-20.
Combine like terms: 3x^2-2x^2=x^2, 7x+4x=11x, constant -9 unchanged, result x^2+11x-9.
Factor 25x^2-81 as difference of squares (5x+9)(5x-9), cancel (5x-9) with denominator, result 5x+9.
Distribute negative sign over second polynomial: 3x^2-11x+4-x^2-7x+9, combine like terms: 2x^2-18x+13.
Distribute 4 over (3x+5) and -2 over (x-9): 12x+20-2x+18, combine like terms: 10x+38.
Factor 6x^2+19x-7 by grouping: split 19x into 21x-2x, get 3x(2x+7)-1(2x+7)=(3x-1)(2x+7), cancel (2x+7), so a=3,b=-1, a*b=-3.
Divide each term by 5x^2: 10x^4/5x^2=2x^2, -15x^3/5x^2=-3x, 20x^2/5x^2=4, result 2x^2-3x+4.
FOIL (3x+4)(2x-5)=6x^2-15x+8x-20=6x^2-7x-20, match coefficients with 6x^2+bx-20 to get b=-7.
Factor numerator (x-6)(x-7), denominator (x-5)(x-6), cancel (x-6) to get (x-7)/(x-5), rewrite as 1+(-2)/(x-5), so k=-2.
Distribute 4 over (3x-8) and -2 over (5x+3): 12x-32-10x-6, combine like terms: 2x-38.
Factor numerator 2x^2+7x-15=(2x-3)(x+5), denominator 2x^2-5x+3=(2x-3)(x-1), cancel (2x-3) to get (x+5)/(x-1).
Factor numerator 2x^2+7x+3=(2x+1)(x+3), cancel (2x+1) with denominator to get x+3.
Distribute 7 over (3x-4) to get 21x-28, combine 21x-5x=16x, result 16x-28.
Factor numerator 4x^2+20x+21=(2x+3)(2x+7), cancel (2x+3) with denominator to get 2x+7.
Multiply monomials: 3*7=21 for coefficients, x^(2+5)=x^7 for exponents, result 21x^7.
Recognize (x^2-4x+4)=(x-2)^2 and (x^2+4x+4)=(x+2)^2 as perfect-square trinomials, product is [(x-2)(x+2)]^2=(x^2-4)^2, expand to x^4-8x^2+16.
Polynomial long division of 7x^2+23x-28 by x+4: quotient 7x-5 remainder -8, so expression equals 7x-5+(-8)/(x+4), a+b+c=7-5-8=-6.
Factor 6x^2+19x-7 by grouping: product 6*(-7)=-42, sum 19 gives 21 and -2, rewrite as 6x^2+21x-2x-7=3x(2x+7)-1(2x+7)=(3x-1)(2x+7).
Find common denominator (x+3)(x-1), cross-multiply: 5(x-1)+2(x+3)=5x-5+2x+6=7x+1, so a=7,b=1,a+b=8.
Recognize 8x^3-27=(2x)^3-3^3 as difference of cubes, factor as (2x-3)(4x^2+6x+9), cancel (2x-3) with denominator, quotient is 4x^2+6x+9, a+b+c=19.
Divide each term by 2x: 4x^3/2x=2x^2, 10x^2/2x=5x, -30x/2x=-15, so a=2,b=5,c=-15, a+b+c=-8.
Factor numerator 2x^2+7x+3=(2x+1)(x+3), denominator 2x^2-5x-3=(2x+1)(x-3), cancel (2x+1), result (x+3)/(x-3).
Distribute 3 over (2x-7) to get 6x-21, combine 6x+4x=10x, result 10x-21.
Distribute 4 over (3x-5) to get 12x-20, combine 12x+7x=19x, result 19x-20.
Factor x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) as difference of squares, cancel (x+3) with denominator to get x-3.
Recognize 8x^3-27 as difference of cubes (2x)^3-3^3=(2x-3)(4x^2+6x+9), cancel denominator (4x^2+6x+9) to get 2x-3.
Factor numerator x^2+7x+12=(x+3)(x+4), denominator x^2-9=(x+3)(x-3), cancel (x+3) to get (x+4)/(x-3), so a=4,b=3,a+b=7.
Divide each term of numerator by 6x^2y^2 using exponent subtraction rules: 18x^5y^3/(6x^2y^2)=3x^3y, 12x^2y^4/(6x^2y^2)=2y^2, giving 3x^3y-2y^2.
Factor numerator 9x^2-49=(3x+7)(3x-7) as difference of squares, cancel (3x+7) with denominator, leaving 3x-7.
Multiply exponents in numerator: x^7*x^3=x^10. Divide by x^4: x^(10-4)=x^6. All distractors misapply exponent rules.
Simplify 9a^3b^5/(3a^{-1}b^2)=3a^4b^3 using exponent rules (subtract neg exponent). Multiply by 2b/a^2 to get 6a^2b^4.
Factor numerator x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) (diff of squares), denominator x^2+5x+6=(x+2)(x+3) (trinomial). Cancel (x+3) to get (x-3)/(x+2).
Combine like terms: 7x^2+4x^2=11x^2, -3x+9x=6x, constant -2 unchanged. Result: 11x^2+6x-2.
Divide coefficients 45/9=5, subtract exponents m^(6-2)=m^4. Result: 5m^4.
Recognize 27x^3+125=(3x)^3+5^3 as sum of cubes, factor as (3x+5)(9x^2-15x+25). Cancel (3x+5) to get 9x^2-15x+25. a+b+c=9-15+25=19.
Recognize 27x^6-8=(3x^2)^3-2^3 as difference of cubes, factor as (3x^2-2)(9x^4+6x^2+4). Cancel (3x^2-2) to get 9x^4+6x^2+4.
Factor out GCF 7x from 7x^2-21x to get 7x(x-3).
Factor 10x^2+31x-14 by grouping: product=-140, sum=31 gives 35,-4. Rewrite as 5x(2x+7)-2(2x+7)=(5x-2)(2x+7). Cancel (2x+7). a+b=5+(-2)=3.
Factor out GCF 3x: 3x(2x^2-5x+3). Factor trinomial by grouping: 2x^2-2x-3x+3=(2x-3)(x-1). Complete: 3x(2x-3)(x-1).
Factor numerator 8x^3+27=(2x+3)(4x^2-6x+9) as sum of cubes. Factor denominator 4x^2-9=(2x-3)(2x+3) as diff of squares. Cancel (2x+3). Result: (4x^2-6x+9)/(2x-3). Sum a+b+c+d+e=4-6+9+2-3=6.
Polynomial long division of 3x^3-13x^2+16x-4 by x-2 yields 3x^2-7x+2. So a+b+c=3-7+2=-2.
Factor all four quadratics: (x+8)(x-5), (x-5)(x-8), (x-8)(x+5), (x+5)(x+8). All factors cancel completely, result=1.
Factor numerator 4x^2-16=4(x-2)(x+2), denominator 2(x+2). Cancel (x+2) and simplify 4/2=2 to get 2(x-2)=2x-4.
Factor numerator 4x^2-25=(2x+5)(2x-5) as difference of squares. Cancel (2x+5) with denominator to get 2x-5.
Simplify radicals: sqrt(50)=5sqrt(2), sqrt(18)=3sqrt(2). Add: 8sqrt(2). Divide by sqrt(2): a=8. a^2=64.
Factor x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) as difference of squares. Cancel (x+3) with denominator to get x-3.
Factor 25x^2-81=(5x+9)(5x-9) as difference of squares. Cancel (5x-9) with denominator to get 5x+9.
Factor out GCF 4x from 8x^2+20x to get 4x(2x+5). Distractors use wrong GCF or fail to divide properly.
Distribute 5 and -3: 10x^2-45x+20 and -3x^2-21x+18. Combine: 7x^2-66x+38. b=-66.
Factor 36x^2-121=(6x+11)(6x-11) as difference of squares. Cancel (6x+11) with denominator to get 6x-11.
Split fraction: 4x^2/(4x)-16x/(4x)=x-4. Divide each term by monomial denominator using exponent rules.
Distribute negative sign: 5x^2-13x+4-3x^2-2x+17. Combine like terms: 2x^2-15x+21.
Factor out GCF 7x from 7x^3-21x^2+14x to get 7x(x^2-3x+2). Distractors use wrong GCF or fail to divide all terms.
Combine fractions in numerator: 1/(x-2)-1/(x+5)=[(x+5)-(x-2)]/[(x-2)(x+5)]=7/[(x-2)(x+5)]. Divide by 4/[(x-2)(x+5)]: multiply by reciprocal, cancel common denominator, get 7/4.
Distribute 3 over (x+4): 3x+12. Distribute -2 over (x-1): -2x+2. Combine: x+14.
Distribute negative: 7x^2-3x+4-2x^2-5x+9. Combine: 5x^2-8x+13.
Use identity a^3+b^3=(a+b)^3-3ab(a+b). Substitute a+b=5, ab=3: 125-3(3)(5)=125-45=80.
Factor 9a^2-49b^2=(3a+7b)(3a-7b) as difference of squares. Cancel (3a+7b) to get 3a-7b.
Distribute 3: 6x^2-21x+12. Distribute -1: -x^2-5x+9. Combine: 5x^2-26x+21.
Distribute 4: 12x-44. Add 7x: 19x-44.
Recognize 25x^2-49y^2=(5x)^2-(7y)^2 as difference of squares. Factor as (5x+7y)(5x-7y).
Distribute 3: 6x^2-21x. Add 4x: 6x^2-17x.
Combine like terms: 3x^2-2x^2=x^2, 7x+4x=11x, constant -9. Result: x^2+11x-9.
Long division of 2x^3+7x^2-17x+3 by 2x+1: quotient x^2+3x-10 remainder 13. b+c+r=3+(-10)+13=6.
Divide each term by 3x: 6x^3/(3x)=2x^2, 15x^2/(3x)=5x. So c=5.
Factor 9x^2-49=(3x+7)(3x-7) as difference of squares. Cancel (3x+7) to get 3x-7.
Divide coefficients 18/6=3. Subtract exponents: a^(5-2)=a^3, b^(3-1)=b^2. Result: 3a^3b^2.
Factor 25x^2-121=(5x-11)(5x+11) as difference of squares. Cancel (5x+11) to get 5x-11.
Combine like terms: 7x²+4x²=11x², -3x+11x=8x → 11x²+8x
Divide each term of numerator by 9x²: 18x⁵/9x²=2x³, -27x³/9x²=-3x, 9x²/9x²=1 → 2x³-3x+1
Factor numerator x(6x²+19x-7)=x(3x-1)(2x+7), denominator x(2x+7), cancel x(2x+7) → 3x-1, a=3,b=-1, ab=-3
Distribute: 3(x+4)=3x+12, -2(x-1)=-2x+2. Combine: x+14
Factor out GCF 3: 3(x²+4x-5), then factor trinomial: 3(x+5)(x-1)
Common denominator (x-5)(x+1)=x²-4x-5. Numerator: 3(x+1)+2(x-5)=5x-7. Result: (5x-7)/(x²-4x-5)
Expand (2x+7)²=4x²+28x+49, subtract 4x²: 28x+49
Divide each term by 3a²b²: 9a⁴b³/3a²b²=3a²b, 15a²b⁵/3a²b²=5b³ → 3a²b-5b³
Recognize difference of squares: 25x²-121=(5x)²-11²=(5x-11)(5x+11)
Factor numerator (x+4)(x+7), denominator (x+7)(x-7). Cancel (x+7) → (x+4)/(x-7)
Divide each term by 7x²: 14x⁴/7x²=2x², -21x³/7x²=-3x, 35x²/7x²=5. c=5
Recognize a²-4a+4=(a-2)², divide by (a-2) → a-2. Substitute a=2x+1: 2x+1-2=2x-1
Distribute 4 and 3: 4x²+20x-8+6x²-3x+18. Combine: 10x²+17x+10
Divide each term by 5x: x²-4x+3, b=-4,c=3, b+c=-1
Expand (2x+5)²=4x²+20x+25, subtract 25: 4x²+20x. Factor 4x(x+5), divide by 4x → x+5
Recognize difference of cubes: 8x³-27=(2x-3)(4x²+6x+9). Divide by (2x-3) → 4x²+6x+9
Factor all four polynomials including difference of squares and perfect square trinomial. Cancel (2x-3) and one (x+3) → (x+7)(x+3)/((x-3)(2x+3))
Difference of squares: 9x⁴-25y²=(3x²+5y)(3x²-5y). Cancel (3x²+5y) → 3x²-5y
Factor num: 4(x-3)(x+3), den: 2(x+3)(x+4). Cancel (x+3), reduce 4/2 → 2(x-3)/(x+4)
Expand (x+3)³ and (x-3)³, subtract: x³ and 27x terms cancel, leaving 18x²+54. a=18,b=54, a+b=72
Factor all four: x²-9 diff of squares, x²+7x+12 trinomial, x²+8x+16 perfect square, x²-x-12 trinomial. Cancel one (x+3) and one (x+4) → (x-3)(x+4)/((x+3)(x-4))
Divide each term by 2x: 4x³/2x=2x², -18x²/2x=-9x, 8x/2x=4. a+b+c=2-9+4=-3
Difference of squares: (3x²)²-(5y³)²=(3x²+5y³)(3x²-5y³). Cancel → 3x²-5y³
Distribute 3(2x-7)=6x-21, add 5x: 11x-21
Factor numerator (x+4)(x+7), cancel (x+4) → x+7
Difference of squares: 25x²-81=(5x)²-9²=(5x-9)(5x+9)
Distribute: 5(2x-3)=10x-15, 4(x+7)=4x+28. Combine: 14x+13
Distribute 5 and -3: 15x²+35x-10-12x²+3x-27. Combine: 3x²+38x-37
Factor: (x-2)(x-7)/((x-2)(x+2)). Cancel (x-2) gives removable discontinuity at x=2
Factor 6x²+17x-14: find factors of -84 summing to 17 (21,-4), group: (2x+7)(3x-2)
Polynomial long division: (10x³-23x²+13x-2)÷(2x-1)=5x²-9x+2. a+b+c=5-9+2=-2
Distribute 3 and negate: 6x²-21x+12-x²-5x+9. Combine: 5x²-26x+21
Expand (2x+3)²=4x²+12x+9, (2x-3)²=4x²-12x+9. Subtract: 24x. Divide by x: 24
Distribute 9(4x-3)=36x-27, add 7x: 43x-27
Difference of squares: 4x²-25=(2x+5)(2x-5). Cancel (2x+5) → 2x-5
Difference of squares: 9x²-49=(3x+7)(3x-7). Cancel (3x-7) → 3x+7, a+b=10
Perfect square: 9x²=(3x)², 2(3x)(b)=42x → b=7, c=b²=49
Factor num: 6x(x-3)(x+3), den: 3x(x-3). Cancel 3x(x-3), reduce: 2(x+3)=2x+6
Factor numerator: (x-11)(x-12). Cancel (x-11) → x-12, k=-12
Distribute 3(2x-7)=6x-21, add 4x: 10x-21
Factor 5x²+23x+12=(5x+3)(x+4) by grouping. Cancel (5x+3) → x+4, k=4
Common denominator (x-5)(x+7)=x²+2x-35. Numerator: 3(x+7)-2(x-5)=x+31
Factor GCF of 3 from 3x^2+9x-15: 3(x^2+3x-5). Distractor A flips sign of -3x, B flips sign of -5, C fails to divide coefficients by 3.
Factor numerator 3x^2+17x-28=(x+7)(3x-4), cancel (x+7) with denominator to get 3x-4, so a=3,b=-4, a-b=7. Distractor B=-1 computes a+b; C=-7 sign error; D=1 misidentifies coefficients.
Distribute 7(2x+9)=14x+63, then combine 14x+63-3x=11x+63. Distractor B fails to distribute 7 to 9; C omits subtracting 3x; D applies wrong sign to 63.
Factor numerator x^2+3x-28=(x+7)(x-4), denominator x^2-16=(x-4)(x+4) (diff of squares), cancel (x-4) to get (x+7)/(x+4). Distractor A has wrong signs; C cancels wrong factor; D reverses both signs.

Factor x^2-11x+28=(x-4)(x-7), x^2-16=(x-4)(x+4) diff of squares, x^2-14x+49=(x-7)^2 perfect square trinomial. Multiply and cancel (x-4),(x+4),(x-7) to get 1/(x-7). Distractor B wrong signs; C incomplete cancellation; D fails to cancel one (x-7).
Factor x^2+13x+36=(x+9)(x+4), x^2-16=(x-4)(x+4) diff of squares, cancel (x+4) to get (x+9)/(x-4). Distractor A misstates factor as x+12; B uses wrong denominator sign; D cancels wrong factor.
Divide 18/6=3, subtract exponents x^(5-2)=x^3, y^(3-1)=y^2 to get 3x^3y^2. Distractor B fails to subtract y exponents; C fails to divide coefficients; D adds exponents instead of subtracting.
Expand denominator (2x^3y^5)^2=4x^6y^10. Then 4x^6y^10/4x^6y^10=1, so k=1.
Multiply monomials: 3*7=21, x^2*x^3=x^(2+3)=x^5, result 21x^5. Distractor A adds coefficients (10); C multiplies exponents (6); D both errors.
Factor 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5) diff of squares, 2x^2+x-15=(2x-5)(x+3). Cancel (2x-5) to get (2x+5)/(x+3). Distractor B cancels wrong factor; C drops denominator entirely; D fails to factor.

Factor 10x^2+29x-14 by grouping: product=-140, sum=29 gives 35,-4. Split: 5x(2x+7)-2(2x+7)=(5x-2)(2x+7). Cancel (5x-2) to get 2x+7. Distractor B sign error; C only divides leading terms; D fails to factor properly.
Recognize 4x^2-49=(2x)^2-7^2 as difference of squares, factor as (2x+7)(2x-7). Distractor A incorrectly splits 4x^2; C squares instead of factoring; D wrong factor pair.
Distribute 9(2x+5)=18x+45, combine 18x+45-13x=5x+45. Distractor A fails to distribute to 5; C adds instead of subtracting 13x; D applies wrong sign to 45.
Factor x^2-13x+42=(x-6)(x-7), x^2-36=(x-6)(x+6) diff of squares. Multiply fractions, cancel (x-6) and (x+6) to get (x-7)/(x-3). Distractor B wrong signs; C incomplete cancellation; D wrong factor.
Combine like terms: 7x^2+4x^2=11x^2, -3x+9x=6x, constant -2. Result: 11x^2+6x-2. Distractor B subtracts x coefficients wrong; C subtracts x^2 terms; D flips sign of constant.
Multiply monomials: 11*2=22, x^5*x^3=x^8. Distractor A multiplies exponents (15); B adds coefficients (13); D both multiply exponents and add coefficients (impossible combo shown as 22x^53).

Factor x^2-25=(x-5)(x+5), rewrite 3/(x-5) with denominator x^2-25 by multiplying by (x+5): 3(x+5)/(x^2-25)=(3x+15)/(x^2-25). Add: (3x+15+7x)/(x^2-25)=(10x+15)/(x^2-25). Distractor B sign error on +15; C fails to multiply numerator; D uses wrong denominator.
Expand 4(3x-7)+x=12x-28+x=13x-28. Match to 13x+m: m=-28.
Factor x^2-11x+28=(x-4)(x-7), cancel (x-4) with denominator to get x-7. Distractor A uses wrong sign (+7); C confuses with denominator; D wrong factor entirely.
Multiply monomials: 9*3=27, x^4*x^3=x^7. Distractor A multiplies exponents (12); C adds coefficients (12); D adds coefficients and multiplies exponents.
Factor 9x^2-16=(3x+4)(3x-4) diff of squares, cancel (3x+4) to get 3x-4. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C fails to take sqrt of 9x^2; D fails to factor.
Factor numerator a^2b-ab^2=ab(a-b) GCF, denominator a^2-2ab+b^2=(a-b)^2 perfect square. Cancel (a-b) to get ab/(a-b). Distractor B uses a+b in denominator; C inverts; D omits b from numerator.
Expand (3x+7)(3x-7)=9x^2-49 via diff of squares, (3x-2)^2=9x^2-12x+4 via perfect square. Subtract: 9x^2-49-9x^2+12x-4=12x-53. So a=12,b=-53, a+b=-41.
Factor GCF 7m from 14m^3-21m^2+7m: 7m(2m^2-3m+1). Distractor A only factors out 7 not 7m; B flips sign of -3m; D flips sign of +1.
Divide 14/7=2, subtract exponents x^(3-1)=x^2, y^(5-2)=y^3. Result 2x^2y^3, so a=2,b=2,c=3, sum=7.
Expand (7x^5)^2=49x^10, divide by 49x^3: 49/49=1, x^(10-3)=x^7. Distractor B fails to cancel 49; C doesn't subtract exponents; D doesn't subtract and has wrong exponent.
Factor 49p^2-25q^2=(7p+5q)(7p-5q) diff of squares, cancel (7p+5q) to get 7p-5q. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C doesn't take square roots; D distributes incorrectly.
Common denominator (x-1)(x+2)=x^2+x-2. Numerator: 2(x+2)+3(x-1)=2x+4+3x-3=5x+1. Distractor A adds fractions naively; B sign error gives 5x+7; D error gives 5x+5.

Factor 5x^2-23x+12 by grouping: product=60, sum=-23 gives -20,-3. Split: 5x(x-4)-3(x-4)=(5x-3)(x-4). Cancel (5x-3) to get x-4, so a=1,b=-4, a+b=-3. Distractor B sign error; C,D wrong factor identification.
Combine like terms: 11x^3+3x^3=14x^3, -4x^2+7x^2=3x^2. Result 14x^3+3x^2. Distractor B subtracts x^2 wrong way; C subtracts x^3 terms; D adds absolute values of x^2 coefficients.
Factor 9x^2-49=(3x-7)(3x+7) diff of squares, 3x^2+13x+14=(3x+7)(x+2). Cancel (3x+7) to get (3x-7)/(x+2). Distractor B wrong sign in numerator; C wrong denominator sign; D oversimplifies.
Common denominator (x+5)(x-2)=x^2+3x-10. Numerator: 3(x-2)-1(x+5)=3x-6-x-5=2x-11. Distractor B fails to distribute negative to 5; C uses wrong cross-multiplication; D both errors cancel most terms.
Factor 10x^2+17x-20 by grouping: product=-200, sum=17 gives 25,-8. Split: 5x(2x+5)-4(2x+5)=(5x-4)(2x+5). Cancel (5x-4) to get 2x+5. Distractor A sign error; C wrong constant; D fails to cancel.
Distribute (2x^2-5x+3)(x+7): 2x^3+14x^2-5x^2-35x+3x+21=2x^3+9x^2-32x+21. Distractor B has -38x (error combining -35x+3x); C flips sign of 21; D has 19x^2 (error in x^2 combination).
Factor 10x^2+31x-14 by grouping: product=-140, sum=31 gives 35,-4. Split: 5x(2x+7)-2(2x+7)=(2x+7)(5x-2). Distractor B reverses sign of 31x; C incorrect grouping; D incorrect factor pair.
Distribute 3(2x-7)=6x-21 and 5(x+4)=5x+20. Combine: 6x+5x=11x, -21+20=-1. Result 11x-1. Distractor B sign error on -1; C adds -21-20; D omits 5x term.

Polynomial long division: 6x^2/(3x)=2x, subtract 2x(3x+4)=6x^2+8x, get -9x-23. Then -9x/(3x)=-3, subtract -3(3x+4)=-9x-12, remainder -11. So 2x-3+(-11)/(3x+4), a=2,b=-3,c=-11, sum=-12. Distractors from arithmetic errors in division steps.
FOIL (3x-7)(2x+5): 6x^2+15x-14x-35=6x^2+x-35. Distractor B reverses sign of middle term; C adds 15x+14x; D subtracts 15x+14x with wrong sign.
Factor all four: (x+2)(x+9)/[(x+2)(x-2)] * (x-2)(x-3)/[(x+9)(x-3)]. Cancel (x+2),(x-2),(x+9),(x-3) to get 1. Distractors from incomplete cancellation.
Distribute 3x^2(2x-7)=6x^3-21x^2, add 5x^2: 6x^3-21x^2+5x^2=6x^3-16x^2. Distractor B forgets +5x^2; C drops -7 in distribution; D drops x^2 from last term.
Factor 9x^2-49=(3x-7)(3x+7) diff of squares, 3x^2+2x-21=(3x-7)(x+3). Cancel (3x-7) to get (3x+7)/(x+3). Distractor B cancels wrong factor; C,D wrong denominator signs.
Factor x^2-49=(x-7)(x+7) diff of squares, x^2+10x+21=(x+3)(x+7). Cancel (x+7) to get (x-7)/(x+3). Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C,D wrong denominator sign.
Distribute 5(2a-3)=10a-15, -4(a+7)=-4a-28. Combine: 10a-4a=6a, -15-28=-43. Result 6a-43. Distractor A fails to distribute negative to 7; C adds instead of subtracts a terms; D partial sign error.
Factor 4x^2-25=(2x+5)(2x-5) diff of squares, cancel (2x+5) to get 2x-5. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C fails to take sqrt; D fails to factor correctly.
Distribute 3(2x^2+5)=6x^2+15, distribute negative -(x^2-4)=-x^2+4. Combine: 6x^2-x^2=5x^2, 15+4=19. Result 5x^2+19. Distractor B subtracts 4; C fails to distribute 3; D both errors.
Factor 4x^2-25=(2x+5)(2x-5) diff of squares, cancel (2x+5) to get 2x-5. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C fails to take sqrt of 4x^2; D divides each term by 2 incorrectly.
Factor 9t^4-25=(3t^2)^2-5^2=(3t^2+5)(3t^2-5) diff of squares, cancel (3t^2+5) to get 3t^2-5. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C fails to factor; D takes sqrt of t^4 wrong.
Divide 39/13=3, subtract exponents n^(8-3)=n^5. Result 3n^5. Distractor B adds exponents; C fails to divide coefficient; D fails to divide coefficient at all.
Factor 9x^2-49=(3x+7)(3x-7) diff of squares, cancel (3x+7) to get 3x-7. Distractor A cancels wrong factor; C fails to take sqrt of 9x^2; D fails to factor correctly.
Distribute 3 and 4 into each polynomial, then combine like terms: 6x^2-15x+4x^2+12x = 10x^2-3x. B treats -5x as +5x (sign error distributing). C omits 4x^2 term. D flips sign on 12x.
Multiply monomials: 11*3=33, x^4*x^5=x^9. A adds coefficients instead of multiplying. B multiplies exponents instead of adding. D makes both errors.

Factor numerator 6x^2+7x-3=(3x-1)(2x+3), denominator 2x^2+7x+6=(2x+3)(x+2). Cancel (2x+3) to get (3x-1)/(x+2). a=3,b=-1,c=1,d=2, sum=5. B: b=1 sign error. C: wrong denominator factoring. D: wrong factoring.
Factor theorem: if (x+2) is a factor, substitute x=-2: 3(-8)+k(4)+34+6=0 => -24+4k+40=0 => 4k=-16 => k=-4.
Factor numerator 4x^3+28x=4x(x^2+7), denominator 2x^2+14=2(x^2+7). Cancel (x^2+7): 4x/2=2x. B: arithmetic slip. C: didn't cancel. D: wrong factoring.
Polynomial long division of 5x^3+17x^2-23x+6 by (x+4): quotient 5x^2-3x-11 remainder 50. c=-11. A: sign error in subtraction step. C: sign error. D: confused remainder with c.
Divide each term by 3x: 6x^3/3x=2x^2, -15x^2/3x=-5x, 9x/3x=3. Result: 2x^2-5x+3. B: didn't reduce exponents. C: didn't divide 9 by 3. D: only divided by 1 not 3x.

Numerator x^2-9=(x+3)(x-3) difference of squares. Denominator x^2-6x+9=(x-3)^2 perfect square trinomial. Cancel (x-3): (x+3)/(x-3). B: reversed numerator/denominator. C: canceled wrong factor. D: wrong factoring.
Complete the square: 3(x^2+6x)+31 = 3(x^2+6x+9-9)+31 = 3(x+3)^2-27+31 = 3(x+3)^2+4. B: subtracted only 9 not 3*9. C: didn't subtract the added 9 at all. D: used h=6 instead of h=3.
Multiply monomials: 3*7=21, x^4*x^3=x^7. A: added coefficients. C: multiplied exponents. D: took min of exponents.
FOIL (3x-8)(4x+5): 12x^2+15x-32x-40 = 12x^2-17x-40. B: treated -8 as +8 in middle terms. C: sign error on constant. D: flipped sign on 15x.
Expand (x+7)^2=x^2+14x+49, (x-7)^2=x^2-14x+49. Subtract: 28x. Or use difference of squares: (2x)(14)=28x. A: assumed equal. B: only counted one 14x. D: added squared terms instead of canceling.
Factor x^2-9x+20: find two numbers multiplying to 20 and summing to -9: -4,-5. Result: (x-4)(x-5). A: wrong sign on 5. B: both positive. D: wrong factor pair.

Common denominator x^2-4=(x+2)(x-2). Rewrite b=2(x-2)/(x^2-4). Subtract: (3x-7-(2x-4))/(x^2-4)=(x-3)/(x^2-4). B: multiplied numerator of a by (x-2). C: sign error distributing negative. D: forgot to distribute.
Distribute: 6x^2-21x+12-2x^2-6x+10. Combine: 4x^2-27x+22. B: sign errors distributing -2. C: constant term error. D: added x^2 coefficients wrong.
Factor GCF 3: 3(x^2-7x+12). Factor trinomial: (x-3)(x-4). Result: 3(x-3)(x-4). B: sign error on 3. C: didn't factor out 3 fully. D: wrong factor pair.
Distribute: 15x^2-10x+35-4x^2+24x-12. Combine: 11x^2+14x+23. A: sign error on -4(-6x). C: constant term error. D: added x^2 coefficients wrong.
Multiply monomials: 7*3=21, x^3*x^5=x^8. A: added coefficients. C: multiplied exponents. D: both errors.
9x^2-49=(3x)^2-7^2=(3x-7)(3x+7) difference of squares. A: didn't take square roots of terms. C: confused with perfect square trinomial. D: wrong factoring.
Factor numerator 49p^2-4q^2=(7p+2q)(7p-2q) difference of squares. Cancel (7p+2q): result 7p-2q. A: kept wrong factor. C: divided coefficients instead of factoring. D: wrong exponent handling.

Numerator 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5). Denominator 2x^2+9x+10=(2x+5)(x+2). Cancel (2x+5): (2x-5)/(x+2). A: kept wrong factor from numerator. C: wrong denominator factoring. D: did polynomial division instead.
Polynomial division: 5x^2+17x-12 / (x+4). First term 5x, subtract 5x^2+20x, get -3x-12. Next term -3, remainder 0. a=5, b=-3, a-b=8. A: computed a+b-2. C: sign error on b. D: sign error on a-b.
Distribute 3(2x-7)=6x-21, add 5x: 11x-21. B: didn't distribute 3 to -7. C: omitted +5x. D: sign error on 21.
49a^2-64b^2=(7a)^2-(8b)^2=(7a-8b)(7a+8b) difference of squares. A: treated as perfect square. C: didn't take sqrt of 49. D: didn't take sqrt of 49 for first factor.
64x^2-9=(8x+3)(8x-3) difference of squares. Divide by (8x+3): 8x-3. B: kept wrong factor. C: subtracted 9 from constant. D: didn't take square roots.
GCF of 7x^2-49x is 7x. Factor: 7x(x-7). A: didn't divide 49 by 7. B: only factored out 7. D: only factored out x.
Partial fractions: 11x-5=A(x+2)+B(x-3). Comparing x-coefficients: A+B=11. Answer is 11 directly. B: solved for A,B individually and added wrong. C: confused with constant term. D: arithmetic error.
Polynomial long division of 2x^3+7x^2-27x+18 by (x+6): quotient 2x^2-5x+3. A: sign error in subtraction step. C: sign error on constant. D: wrong leading coefficient.

Substitute u=x^2: u^2-13u+36=(u-4)(u-9)=(x^2-4)(x^2-9). Factor each as difference of squares: (x-2)(x+2)(x-3)(x+3). A: stopped at first factoring. C: confused with perfect square. D: didn't factor fully.
9x^2-16=(3x+4)(3x-4) difference of squares. Divide by (3x+4): 3x-4. A: kept wrong factor. C: didn't take sqrt. D: incomplete simplification.
x^2-y^2=(x-y)(x+y). Substitute x-y=4: 4(x+y)=28, x+y=7.
Numerator 4x^2+28x+49=(2x+7)^2 perfect square trinomial. Divide by (2x+7): 2x+7. a=2, b=7, sum=9.
Numerator x^2+3x-28=(x+7)(x-4). Denominator x^2-16=(x+4)(x-4) difference of squares. Cancel (x-4): (x+7)/(x+4). A: wrong sign in numerator factor. B: canceled wrong factor. D: flipped result.
Multiply monomials: 3*7=21, x^2*x^3=x^5. A: added coefficients. B: multiplied exponents. D: both multiply coefficients and multiply exponents.
Factor 4x^2+23x-35=(x+7)(4x-5). Divide by (x+7): 4x-5. a=4, b=-5, a-b=9. B: computed a+b. C: sign error. D: reversed subtraction.
Long division of 4x^2+11x-7 by (x+3): 4x gives 4x^2+12x, subtract to get -x-7. -1 gives -x-3, remainder -4. a=4,b=-1,c=-4, sum=-1. B: sign error. C: wrong remainder. D: confused signs.
Distribute: 6x^2-21x+12-2x^2-10x+6 = 4x^2-31x+18. B: sign error distributing -2 to 5x. C: sign error on constant. D: didn't distribute -2 to x^2.
x^3-8=(x-2)(x^2+2x+4) difference of cubes. Cancel (x^2+2x+4): x-2. A: sign error in cube formula. C: kept denominator as answer. D: confused with (x-2)^2.
Both terms share factor (2x-7). Factor out: (2x-7)(5x+3). B: sign error on 3. C: sign error on -7. D: expanded instead of factoring.
4x^2+20x+25=(2x+5)^2 perfect square trinomial. Divide by (2x+5): 2x+5. A: confused with difference of squares. B: wrong division. C: didn't cancel.
Distribute: 2x^2-6+4x^2=6x^2-6. A: didn't distribute 2 to -3. C: forgot to add 4x^2. D: sign error on constant.
Combine like terms: 7x^2+4x^2=11x^2, -3x+9x=6x. Result: 11x^2+6x. B: sign error on x terms. C: subtracted x^2 terms. D: added absolute values of x terms.
Factor 10x^2+29x-21 by grouping: product=10*(-21)=-210, sum=29 => 35,-6. Rewrite: 10x^2+35x-6x-21=5x(2x+7)-3(2x+7)=(2x+7)(5x-3). B: wrong factor pair. C: wrong grouping. D: sign errors.
Divide each term by 3x: 6x^3/3x=2x^2, -12x^2/3x=-4x. Result: 2x^2-4x. B: didn't reduce exponents. C: only divided second term's coefficient by 1. D: divided by x only.
Distribute: 14x^2-21x+35-12x^2-4x+36 = 2x^2-25x+71. A: added x^2 coefficients. B: sign error on -4x. C: constant error.
Factor 2 from both: (3x^3+7x^2-5x+3)/(x+3). Long division gives 3x^2-2x+1. a=3,b=-2,c=1, sum=2.
(x^3)^4=x^12 power rule. x^12*x^5=x^17 product rule. n=17.
4x^2+20x+25=(2x+5)^2 perfect square trinomial. Divide by (2x+5): 2x+5. B: confused with difference of squares. C: divided only first and last terms. D: incomplete simplification.
Recognize 27x^3+125 as sum of cubes (3x)^3+5^3, factor as (3x+5)(9x^2-15x+25), cancel (3x+5) with denominator to get 9x^2-15x+25.
Rewrite negative exponents as fractions, find common denominators, factor y^2-x^2 as difference of squares (y-x)(y+x), cancel (y+x) to get (y-x)/(xy).
Polynomial long division of 6x^3+7x^2+5x+12 by 2x+3 yields quotient 3x^2-x+4 with remainder 0.
FOIL (3x-7)(2x+11): 6x^2+33x-14x-77 = 6x^2+19x-77. Distractors from sign errors in combining middle terms.
Factor 9x^2-16 as difference of squares (3x-4)(3x+4), cancel (3x-4) with denominator to get 3x+4.
Expand (5x+3)^2=25x^2+30x+9 and (5x-3)^2=25x^2-30x+9, subtract to get 60x. Or use difference of squares: (10x)(6)=60x.
Factor x^4-16 as (x^2+4)(x^2-4) using difference of squares, cancel (x^2+4), get x^2-4 so a=1, b=-4, a+b=-3.
Use difference of squares for first product: 9x^2-121. Expand perfect square: 9x^2+12x+4. Subtract with sign distribution: -12x-125.
Divide coefficients 14/2=7, subtract exponents p^(9-3)=p^6, giving 7p^6 so b=6.
Distribute 3(2x+4)=6x+12, distribute -2(x-1)=-2x+2, combine like terms: 4x+14.
Factor 16x^4-81 as difference of squares (4x^2-9)(4x^2+9), cancel (4x^2+9) to get 4x^2-9.
Distribute 4(3x-2)=12x-8, add 7x to get 19x-8.
Factor 6x^2+19x-7 by grouping: (3x-1)(2x+7), cancel (2x+7) to get 3x-1.
Distribute 3(x+4)=3x+12, subtract 2x to get x+12.
Factor x^2-11x+28=(x-4)(x-7), x^2-49=(x-7)(x+7). Cancel (x-7) and (x+7) across the product to get (x-4)/(x-2).
Distribute 7(3x-4)=21x-28, add 11x to get 32x-28.
Recognize 125p^3-64q^3 as difference of cubes (5p)^3-(4q)^3. Apply a^3-b^3=(a-b)(a^2+ab+b^2) to get (5p-4q)(25p^2+20pq+16q^2).
Multiply monomials: 5*9=45, x^3*x^4=x^(3+4)=x^7, giving 45x^7.
Divide each term by 3x^2y^2: first term 3x^2y, second term 5y^3, result 3x^2y-5y^3.
Combine like terms: 3x^2-2x^2=x^2, 7x+4x=11x, constant -11. Result: x^2+11x-11.
Divide each term by 3x^2y^2: 9x^4y^3/(3x^2y^2)=3x^2y, 6x^2y^5/(3x^2y^2)=2y^3, result 3x^2y-2y^3.
Polynomial long division of 2x^2+11x-3 by x+6 gives 2x-1 remainder 3, so a=2, b=-1, c=3, a+b+c=4.
Distribute 3x(7x-11)=21x^2-33x, add 4 to get 21x^2-33x+4.
Factor 6x^2+17x-14: product 6*(-14)=-84, sum 17 gives 21 and -4. Rewrite and group: (3x-2)(2x+7).
Combine like terms: 11x^2-4x^2=7x^2, 5x+13x=18x. Result: 7x^2+18x.
Expand (3x+2)^2 and (x-4)^2, subtract, get 8x^2+20x-12. Factor 4(2x^2+5x-3)=4(2x-1)(x+3). Denominator 2(x+3), cancel (x+3) and simplify to 2(2x-1)=4x-2.
Multiply monomials: 7*3=21, x^3*x^4=x^(3+4)=x^7, so n=7.
Long division or factor 6x^2+17x-14=(2x+7)(3x-2) by grouping. Cancel (2x+7) to get 3x-2, so b=-2.
Factor 16x^2-49=(4x+7)(4x-7) as difference of squares, cancel (4x+7) to get 4x-7.
Factor 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5) as difference of squares, cancel (2x+5) to get 2x-5.
Distribute 3(x^2+5x)=3x^2+15x, distribute -2(x^2-4x)=-2x^2+8x. Combine: x^2+23x.
Factor out GCF 4x: 4x(3x^2+5x-2). Factor trinomial by grouping: (3x-1)(x+2). Fully factored: 4x(3x-1)(x+2).
Factor 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5) as difference of squares, cancel (2x+5) to get 2x-5.
Divide each term by 3x: 9x^3/3x=3x^2, -15x^2/3x=-5x, 6x/3x=2. Result: 3x^2-5x+2.
Combine like terms: 3x^2+5x^2=8x^2, -7x+4x=-3x, 11+(-9)=2. Result: 8x^2-3x+2.
Factor 49t^2-81=(7t+9)(7t-9) as difference of squares, cancel (7t+9) to get 7t-9, so a=7, b=-9, a+b=-2.
Long division of 6x^2+17x-14 by 3x-2 gives 2x+7 with remainder 0. Or factor numerator as (3x-2)(2x+7) and cancel.
Group (6x^3-9x^2)+(14x-21), factor each: 3x^2(2x-3)+7(2x-3), pull out (2x-3) to get (3x^2+7)(2x-3).
Long division of 5x^2+3x-11 by x+2: quotient 5x-7, remainder 3. So a=5, b=-7, c=3, a+b+c=1.
By Remainder Theorem, evaluate p(3)=2(27)-5(9)+9-7=54-45+9-7=11.
Factor all four quadratics: (x-4)(x-7), (x-4)(x+1), (x+1)(x+4), (x-7)(x+7). Cancel (x-4), (x-7), (x+1) to get (x+4)/(x+7).
Distribute 7(3x-11)=21x-77, add 4x to get 25x-77.
Factor 4x^2-49=(2x-7)(2x+7) as difference of squares, factor 2x^2+5x-7=(x-1)(2x+7). Cancel (2x+7) to get (2x-7)/(x-1).
Factor out GCF 3x from 3x^2+21x to get 3x(x+7).
Distribute 3 over (x+4) to get 3x+12, subtract 2x, combine like terms to get x+12. B fails to distribute to constant; C adds instead of subtracts x terms; D sign error on subtraction.

Factor x^2+11x+28=(x+4)(x+7), cancel (x+4). Factor x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3), cancel (x-3). Subtract (x+7)-(x+3)=4. A: subtraction error in constants. C: reversed subtraction order. D: only simplified first fraction.
FOIL (4x-9)(2x+7): 8x^2+28x-18x-63=8x^2+10x-63. A: sign error on middle terms. C: added magnitudes 28+18=46. D: wrong sign on constant.
FOIL (3x+11)(2x-5): 6x^2-15x+22x-55=6x^2+7x-55. B: sign error on middle term. C: wrong sign on constant. D: added magnitudes 15+22=37.
Distribute 5(2x-3)=10x-15, add 4x to get 14x-15. B: sign error distributing -3. C: forgot to add 4x. D: failed to distribute 5 to -3.
Factor 25x^2-49=(5x-7)(5x+7) as difference of squares. Cancel (5x-7) to get 5x+7. A: picked wrong factor. C: kept squared coefficient. D: incomplete factorization.
Divide each term by 2x: 4x^3/2x=2x^2, -18x^2/2x=-9x, 14x/2x=7 giving 2x^2-9x+7. B: only divided 14x by x not 2x. C: only divided by x. D: only divided coefficients by 2.
Polynomial long division of 3x^3+5x^2-26x+11 by 3x-1 gives x^2+2x-8 remainder 3. a=1,b=2,c=-8,r=3, sum=-2. B: arithmetic slip in remainder. C: sign error on c. D: omitted remainder.
GCF of 14m^3 and 21m^2 is 7m^2. Factor out: 7m^2(2m-3). A: only factored out 7m. B: sign error (+3 instead of -3). D: over-factored, extracting m^3.
Distribute 3(2x-5)=6x-15, add 4x to get 10x-15. B: multiplication error 3*5. C: forgot to add 4x. D: sign error distributing -5.

Factor x from numerator and denominator: x(3x^2+11x-4)/x(x+5)=(3x^2+11x-4)/(x+5). Long division: 3x^2/(x)=3x, remainder -4x-4; -4x/(x)=-4, remainder 16. Result: 3x-4+16/(x+5), so a=3,b=-4,c=16, sum=15.

Factor numerator 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5) as difference of squares. Factor denominator 2x^2+9x+10=(2x+5)(x+2) by grouping. Cancel (2x+5) to get (2x-5)/(x+2). B: sign error in numerator. C: cancelled wrong factor. D: incorrect factorization.

Factor out GCF 3x: 3x(x^2-4). Then recognize x^2-4 as difference of squares: 3x(x+2)(x-2). A: only partially factored (missed difference of squares). B: incorrectly treated x^2-4 as linear. C: only factored out 3, not x.

8x^3-27=(2x)^3-3^3 is difference of cubes. Using a^3-b^3=(a-b)(a^2+ab+b^2): (2x-3)(4x^2+6x+9). Cancel (2x-3) to get 4x^2+6x+9. a+b+c=4+6+9=19. A: omitted middle term. C: sign error on middle term. D: confused with 3^3=27.
Distribute 5(3x-4)=15x-20, add 2x to get 17x-20. B: failed to distribute 5 to -4. C: forgot to add 2x. D: sign error making constant positive.

Distribute 7(2x^2-5x+3)=14x^2-35x+21. Distribute -4(3x^2+2x-9)=-12x^2-8x+36. Combine: 2x^2-43x+57. B: added x^2 coefficients instead of subtracting. C: sign errors distributing -4. D: sign error on constant when distributing -4.

Factor 6x^2+19x-7: product 6*(-7)=-42, sum 19 -> 21 and -2. Rewrite: 6x^2+21x-2x-7=3x(2x+7)-1(2x+7)=(3x-1)(2x+7). A: incorrect grouping yields wrong expansion. B: sign error on middle term. C: wrong factor pairing.
